caltable.scope: Existing casacore table or saved view. Supports local, home-relative and configured data paths.

axis.scope: Complex amplitude, phase in radians, real or imaginary projection, or a literal scalar or array column.

datacolumn.scope: For complex projection axes only, the literal column name with CASA's corrected and model aliases. The default reads GAIN from legacy tables.

behaviors.title: Descriptive calibration statistics
behaviors.scope: CASA scalar and array return records, complex projections, real delays, flags retained in the sample population, literal column aliases, single-precision samples and squares, vector components, saved table views, argument errors and local, home-relative and configured data paths.
behaviors.gap: The documented NaN behavior difference is recorded below.

decisions.inputs: A table column with both numeric values and NaN samples.
decisions.casa: The median, quartile range and bounds can change when the same NaN moves between rows.
decisions.ours: Preserves deterministic bounds over non-NaN samples, counts every sample and reports undefined moments and quantiles.
decisions.rationale: The moments and quantiles of the unmasked data are undefined when a sample is NaN.
decisions.impact: The selected row order does not change the native NaN policy.

paired.kind: Same-input public task and table tool comparisons
paired.scope: CASA scalar and array return records, complex projections, real delays, flags retained in the sample population, literal column aliases, single-precision samples and squares, vector components, saved table views, argument errors and local, home-relative and configured data paths.
paired.result: 25 result comparisons, 17 error cases, four table-tool comparisons and independent moment checks passed.
